eps.d: Bugs Bunny tells the story of how Tiny Toon Adventures was created.
Plucky brags about his strengths and talents (that he doesn't actually have) to two new students, who turn out to be from another planet and kidnap him.

Babs and Buster spin a wheel with all the main characters on it to decide who will be the star of the next of several cartoons. #1 - "Devil Doggie" - Dizzy Devil becomes Elmyra's new pet. #2 - "Optical Intrusion" - Furrball stumbles on a pair of 3D glasses that work far too well.

#1 - "Never Too Late to Loon" - Plucky fears he'll fail a math test, so he gets Shirley the Loon to give him Einstein's brain. #2 - "Lil' Sneezer" - Furrball gets a class assignment from Sylvester to catch a mouse. But the mouse he goes after is allergic to almost everything.

This episode serves up a spoof of the Mickey Mouse Club between cartoons. #1 - "Buffed Bunny" - Buster goes to the gym in order to bulk up and impress Babs. #2 - "Squish" - Shirley the Loon tells Dizzy Devil that he could come back as a bug in his next life when she catches him squishing bugs for fun. #3 - "Born to be Riled" - Babs impersonates all her friends, insulting them all in the process.
Babs is sent home from school after impersonating her teacher, Elmer Fudd. Feeling noone understands her, she runs away to Wackyland.

eps.t: Journey to the Center of Acme Acres
eps.d: During an earthquake, Hamton and Plucky fall into a crevice down to the center of the Earth, where gremlins live, angry that someone has stolen their gold.

eps.t: Stuff That Goes Bump in the Night
eps.d: #1 - "Home Wrecker" - Buster becomes a poltergeist, tormenting Montana Max when he builds a summer home on top of Buster's hole in the ground. #2 - "Fang You Very Much" - Elmyra's latest package from the Acme Pet of the Month Club is a bat, of the vampire kind. #3 - "Easy Biter" - Hamton has to battle a mosquito when he's trying to sleep.

The "Buster Bunny Bunch" show is live, with an audience full of Elmyras. #1 - "Bag That Bunny" - Elmyra hires Calamity Coyote to catch Buster to be her pet. #2 - "Lifestyles of the Rich and Rotten" - Montana does whatever it takes to avoid being interviewed by reporters Babs and Buster.

eps.t: Looking Out for the Little Guy
eps.d: Buster explains that these cartoons are all about someone trying to look out for someone smaller than they are. #1 - "Awful Orphan" - Lil' Sneezer gets left on Elmyra's doorstep, and is too much for Elmyra to handle. #2 - "The Re-Return of the Toxic Revenger" - Montana Max is stealing the water from the swamp, and it's up to superhero Plucky to stop him.

In a spoof of the movie "An American Tail", when Elmyra causes a family of fleas to abandon their home on her pet dog, the son ends up on Furrball while the rest of the family lands on a dog that's chasing him.
Dr. Gene Splicer is performing animal mutation experiments, and it's up to Buster and his pals to stop him.

A triple shot of Furrball-centered cartoons. #1 - "K-9 Kitty" - A nearly-blind couple that hate cats take in Furrball who pretends to be a dog. #2 - "Aroma Amore" - In a twist of the old Pepe Le Pew cartoons, Furrball gets a stripe down his back from a street-lane painting truck, and Fifi the Skunk finds him attractive.

A parody of TV series The Twilight Zone, hosted by Buster. #1 - "A Walk on the Flip Side" - Montana Max dreams that he's become a rabbit. #2 - "A Bacon Strip" - Hamton and Plucky go skinny-dipping in Montana's pool. #3 - "Senserely Yours, Babs" - Babs loses her sense of humor, so Hamton and Calamity attempt to capture it.

Buster showcases various trends from the 90s. #1 - "Whining Out" - Hamton insists Plucky, Buster, and Babs try to get in with him to a really posh restaurant. #2 - "Paper Trained" - Montana Max goes out of his way to not pay Buster for his newspaper subscription... two dollars. #3 - "Butt Out" - Babs vs. two smoking rats.
When he loses his soccer ball down a hole during a game, Buster accidentally replaces it with an egg he found in the same location, which turns out to be a T. Rex.
It's time for the prom at Acme Looniversity. Buster has to learn to dance when Babs asks him to go.
Buster is finally caught by Elmyra, and works on an escape attempt both for him and all the other animals Elmyra has captured.
Elmyra captures Buster, who must bust out of her cuddly prison.
Buster and Babs browse the huge selection of films at their local theatre, including "Superbabs," "Duck Trek" and "Pasadena Jones."
Plucky tries to fix the rigged "request day" machine.
Max frames Buster, who gets sent to prison with his lawyer, Plucky.

eps.t: Wake Up Call of the Wild
eps.d: Hamton is a reporter who tries to uncover the meaning of Montana Max's uttered "Acme."
The Bunnys consider instinct and their relation to the wild creatures.

eps.t: You Asked for It, Part II
eps.d: A parody of "Peter And The Wolf."
Dizzy and Hamton are "The Weird Couple," Plucky takes on Monty's polluting factory in"The Return Of The Toxic Revenger" and Hamton clings to his diet in "Little Cake Of Horrors."
Plucky, Hamton and the Bunnys go abroad for a tour of Europe.

Bjorn Bunny thwarts Max's rigged tennis tournament in "Tennis The Menace." Dizzy and Furrball try to fool Arnold in "Bleacher Bummer," and the Vanderbunnys teach Roderick and Rhubella a lesson in "Miniature Goof."

The bored toons act up on a rainy day. Max's rent-a-friend delivery turns out to be an old enemy in "Rent A Friend." A napping Babs dreams in "Bunny Daze," and the Bunnys tunnel toward Aruba but make a wrong turn in "Fur-Gone Conclusion."
Babs searches for a female role model.
The toons try to free Wackyland creatures trapped in a circus sideshow.

Concord takes over Cupid's job in "Love Among The Toons." Elmyra goes wild while cleaning house in "Elmyra's Spring Cleaning" and Plucky and Dizzy battle for prizes on a humiliating game show in "That's Incredibly Stupid."

Calamaty Coyote sees his life flash before his eyes in "Piece Of Mind." Hamton wimps out of dissecting a frog in class in "Class Cut-Up." A bored Plucky uses binoculars to snoop from his hospital bed in "Rear Window Pain."

Tyrone Turtle must cross a highway to escape Elmyra in "Turtle Hurdle." Elmyra bungles her babysitting in "Drooley Davey" and friendly dog Barky Marky loses his love of fetch after playing with Elmyra in "Go Fetch."
Plucky builds a time machine to avoid failing a class.
Plucky rushes to do his Animation 101 project at the last moment.
The toons get part-time jobs. As fast-food workers the Bunnys must serve Max in "Buster's Guide To Part Time Jobs." Toy salesman Hamton assists Elmyra in "Working Pig."

A scientist spills a hunger-inducing flavor-enhancer on Hamton in "Scentimental Pig." Sweetie programs Furrball to want to eat "Pit Bullied." Plucky the Toxic Revenger attacks Max's polluting ice-cream-spoon factory in "Duck In The Muck."

The Bunnys travel through Plucky's brain and encounter a costumed Plucky relating the story of his superhero adventures in "Bat's All Folks." Plucky gets stuck in the all-eyeball state on class picture day in "Wild Takes Class."
Acme Loo's winless season is no deterence to Perfecto kids determined to ensure their team will win the game.

Buster and Babs create the rules as they go on a date in "Buster's Guide To Dating." Fifi thinks a tarred and feathered Calamity is another skunk in "Love Stinks." And Elmyra looks for love on "The Dating Game."

Buster's friends worry about his safety when he's sent to the principal's office in "The Learning Principal," Sweetie searches for Bookworm in "Eating Between The Lines" and Plucky runs into Elmyra when he fakes illness in "What's Up Nurse."
Plucky panics as Granny begins quizzing the class and handing out homework punishments for wrong answers in "One Minute Till Three." Plucky swipes a candy bar in "Sticky Feathers Duck".
Hamton faces off against Montana Max.
The toons set out to restore a kidnapped baby whale and punish its abducter.
Dizzy's transformed into the perfect friend when Mr. Popular hooks him up to a personality implanter in "Dapper Diz." Hamton's imaginary friends turns into a jerk in "A Pigment Of His Imagination."

Plucky's guilt drives him insane in "Plucky's Dastardly Deed," Hamton is frustrated by his hyper-intelligent locker in "Open And Shut Case" and Plucky, Buster and Hamton try to move a piano down from the top of a tower in "C Flat Or B Sharp?"

Hamton tries to get into a cool dance club in "Mr. Popular's Rules Of Cool," Plucky and Hamton compete in a parody of "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles" in "Slugfest" and Max hunts a street-smart deer in "Venison Anyone?"
Buster is mistaken for a brought-to-life toy in "Bunnochio," and Elmyra plays Goldilocks in "Bear Necessities."
Daffy is framed for the kidnapping of Bugs Bunny, and the tiny toons try to break him out of jail while solving the crime.
Max sings motown, Buster spoofs the Sorcerer's Apprentice and Babs performs "Respect" in this parody of MTV.

eps.t: The Return to the Acme Acres Zone
eps.d: Another Zone show, and this time, Babs gets in the act. Real Kids Don't Eat Broccoli: Buster is a futuristic private detective who is hired to find a pretty lady's androids. This search leads him to a club where he is met by thre pretty lady and her friends. It turns out that all of the kids are eating broccoli and Buster uncovers them as the missing droids.

Buster and Babs host a home shopping network styled show and features a lot of shorts. Oh, For Art's Sake: Plucky needs an art project done, and so he resorts to pausing all of the action of a dog and cat fight with his VCR remote and submitting it as artwork. He become very popular and opens his own gallary featuring paused-action cat and dogs.

Buster and Babs have fun at the Acme Looniversity Library, where they have to face the wrath of loud librarian Foghorn Leghorn. Robin Hare: This rendition of ""Robin Hood"" features Buster and his merry men fighting the Sheriff of Naughty Ham (Montana Max) to get the money back to the poor.
Buster and Babs answer mail from faithful viewers. Pluck of the Irish: Plukcy and Hamton spend the night in an Irish castle to get rid of a sad Banshee.

eps.t: Son of the Wacko World of Sports
eps.d: The Wacko World of Sports strikes again! Buster at the Bat: This episode is a parody of the famous ""Casey at the Bat"" poem with a twist ending. Buster makes a home run at the end of the game.
Toxic Revenger fights litterbugs; rain forest; toxic waste in Wackyland.
Buster procrastinates; Elmyra is locked in a mall; an ant hates sugar.
Buster, Babs and Max do a version of Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Moriarity. Then Buster-as-knight must rescue damsel-in-distress Babs.
An eagle thinks he's Sweetie's father. Sweetie is insulted when Furrball declines to eat her. Sweetie performs as Poe's famous bird.
A host of new characters are auditioned, including The Roches, singing roach sisters who play in Hamton's kitchen. Then Plucky dreams he's a private eye.
Plucky and Buster try to make Hamton laugh so hard he'll snort milk out his nose. Then a television program convinces Plucky that Hamton's a wanted criminal.
Buster, Babs, Hamton and Plucky search for treasure despite warnings of a certain green-eyed monster.
Buster and Babs take over the television station.
Buster and Babs become lost in a ghost town being terrorized by coyote bandits.
Grandmother visits; a lifeguard; a bug meets a kite.
The gang become junior firefighters; paintings come to life; tour of a slaughterhouse.
Dizzy Devil learns to read; a robot goes to college.
Hamton's parents leave him home alone.
Birthday gifts; Max's father takes his toys away; Furrball plays with a ribbon.
Elmyra's doll comes to life; Babs and Plucky count their yearbook pictures.
Sendups of television shows.
Buster and Babs perform a tropical new script sent in by eighth graders.
A bombing at a comedy club; potty training; Buster's joke dies.
The girls seek classy prep-school guys; Monty's evening with Elmyra.
Plucky spoofs the Kon-Tiki voyage.
The Toons do "Sunset Boulevard."
Elmyra is kidnapped.
The problems of Toon teens.
Plucky is "Batduck"; silent movies; Marx-Brothers-style mayhem in a hotel.
Hamton destroys Plucky's bagpipe; Elmyra learns about friendship; Steven Spielberg calls.
Buster explores the Toons' personalities.
A family of fleas breaks free of a tyrannous tick.
Plucky wants a part in "Batman."
The Toons take over the animation studio.
Buster hosts a horror show.
The Toons save old cartoon characters.
Buster directs two cartoons.
The Toons go to Washington.
The Toons make more music videos.
Elmyra's grandmother is believed dead.
A folk singer; Sneezer's stinky trumpet; dancing partners.

eps.t: The Horror of Slumber Party Mountain
eps.d: The Toons get spooked while camping.
Plucky plays golf; Elmyra goes under the sea.
The Toons send up "Saturday Night Live."
A dog finds a new owner; Plucky crashes a party; homeless.
Buster prevents Yosemite Sam's promotion; Monty fires his butler; a class assignment.

eps.t: It's a Wonderful Tiny Toon Christmas Special
eps.d: Buster Bunny feels down after the failure of his play and wishes he had never become a Tiny Toon, so a Guardian angel shows Buster what life would have been like without him.
